name: manual_18da80
claim: When a resolver gains a default location such as a CI checkout, neutralize that location in the shared test fixture for every test that asserts nothing is found, and add one test proving the fallback is used. CI has the location and a laptop does not, so the failure appears only in CI; create the location locally and run the suite before pushing.

decisions.notes: A new fallback path made four fail-closed tests stop raising in both CI jobs while they passed locally.

rationale: A new fallback path made four fail-closed tests stop raising in both CI jobs while they passed locally.
